extensionAttribute.description: Reports whether Time Machine is enabled (AutoBackup=1).
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Time Machine Enabled Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
desiredValue="EditFromTemplate_Desired_Value"
raw=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.TimeMachine AutoBackup 2>/dev/null)
case "$raw" in 1) value="true" ;; 0) value="false" ;; "") value="Domain or Key Not Found" ;; *) value="$raw" ;; esac
if [[ "$value" == "$desiredValue" ]]; then echo "<result>Pass ($value)</result>" else echo "<result>Fail ($value)</result>" fi
